commits.subject: Set fsType to 0, installable embedding
commits.body:
Installable embedding. The value exists only in the release: google/fonts
93550bd32 (2017-05-09, #931 "hotfix-titilliumweb: v1.002 added") changed
every shipped binary from 8 to 0. This source, and the binary FontForge
exported from it, state 8 (editable). The OFL shipped with the font already
permits embedding.
